responsibility: Implements GCC’s COBOL front end and its companion driver integration. This module covers the full COBOL language pipeline from command-line and build registration through source ingestion, preprocessing-style COPY/REPLACE and compiler-directive handling, lexical normalization of fixed/free/reference formats, and Bison/Flex-based parsing of COBOL programs, divisions, data descriptions, statements, intrinsics, files, and exceptions. Its core semantic infrastructure is the COBOL symbol table and name-resolution logic, together with diagnostics and parser support code that enforce COBOL-specific rules. On the lowering side, it translates parsed constructs into GCC GENERIC using layered code-generation APIs and utilities, including runtime-structure modeling, arithmetic and exception semantics, data addressing, and calls into libgcobol support routines. The module also contains the language-hook bridge for cobol1 plus gcobol driver/spec logic, making gcc/cobol the subsystem responsible for recognizing COBOL source, analyzing its language semantics, and emitting GCC IR and runtime linkage appropriate for COBOL programs.
